name: Bud & Mary's Manufacturing Facility
old_description: There’s no THC cap on Iowa Medical cannabis products, and getting a medical marijuana card is simple. Get your med card today and find a dispensary near you!
about:
Bud & Mary's Manufacturing Facility is based in Des Moines, Iowa, and was founded in 2005. The company operates medical cannabis dispensaries in Des Moines and Sioux City, serving patients through retail locations.

The company dispenses medical cannabis products including concentrates, vapes, edible tablets, THC dissolvable powder, creams, and tinctures. In January 2025, it launched its first live resin cannabis product for the Iowa medical market. The company also runs a patient rewards and referral program that offers points for successful referrals.

Bud & Mary's serves medical cannabis patients in Iowa, with qualifying conditions including chronic pain, multiple sclerosis, and other ailments. The Iowa medical cannabis program, established in 2018, allows cannabis-derived THC products produced from in-state plants. The company's dispensaries provide access to these regulated, third-party tested products.

The company emphasizes that there is no THC cap on Iowa medical cannabis products and highlights a simple medical card application process through the Iowa Department of Health and Human Services. It has also supported community organizations, donating $15,000 to Easterseals Iowa in February 2025.

name: BudCo Electric
old_description: When your home or business needs reliable electrical work done right the first time, you want a licensed, local electrician who actually shows up on time and stands behind the work. From electrical panel upgrades and EV charger installation to 24-hour emergency electrical services, our licensed team handles it all, safely, cleanly, and at fair prices.
about:
BudCo Electric operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, serving the Pikes Peak region as a locally owned electrical contracting company. The firm's licensed electricians live and work in the community, addressing the area's mix of older neighborhoods with aging wiring and newer subdivisions demanding modern load capacity.

The company provides a full scope of residential and commercial electrical services. Core work includes electrical panel replacements and upgrades, EV charger installations, whole-home rewiring, indoor lighting and ceiling fan wiring, whole-home surge protection, standby generator installation, and 24-hour emergency response. Commercial projects cover tenant improvements, office build-outs, exterior lighting, and three-phase power upgrades. Most panel replacements are completed in a single day, and emergency calls are answered around the clock.

BudCo serves homeowners, landlords, builders, property managers, and general contractors across Colorado Springs and El Paso County, including zip codes from 80903 to 80938 and communities such as Black Forest, Monument, Security-Widefield, Fort Carson, Fountain, Cimarron Hills, Gleneagle, and Peyton. Military families at Fort Carson and rural property owners in Black Forest are noted customer segments.

The company emphasizes work done right the first time, with no shortcuts or guesswork. It promises straight answers and honest pricing before work begins, technicians who arrive on time and protect the job site, and a commitment to keeping money and tradespeople local.

name: Buhler Inc
old_description: Bühler Networking Days 2025: growing business, lowering footprint
about:
The U.S. subsidiary operates as a key node in Bühler's worldwide network, delivering process solutions and equipment from its Minnesota base.

The company designs and manufactures a broad range of process technologies for food, feed, and advanced materials. Its portfolio includes extrusion systems such as the Nutrex 7 series, vacuum thin-film coating under the Leybold Optics brand, die-casting equipment for automotive megacasting, and milling, grinding, and optical sorting machinery. Buhler also provides installation, maintenance, training, and digital services through a 24/7 hotline and application centers.

Buhler serves customers across the food and feed spectrum — including cocoa and chocolate, coffee, baked goods, pet food, aqua feed, and alternative proteins — as well as advanced-materials sectors such as battery materials, semiconductors, precision optics, paints and coatings, and automotive glass coating. Notable collaborations include long-term die-casting partnerships with Hyundai and the supply of megacasting technology for the Volvo EX60.

Bühler states its purpose as creating innovations for a better world, with a focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. The company emphasizes that its technologies touch billions of people daily, from food processing to smartphone components, and it aims to lower environmental footprint while growing business.

name: Burmeister Woodwork Co
old_description: Burmeister woodwork has been producing the finest architectural millwork since 1937
about:
Burmeister Woodwork Co operates from Hales Corners, Wisconsin, just south of Milwaukee. The business traces its origins to the early 1920s when Marvin Burmeister founded Advance Millwork; the name was changed to Burmeister Woodwork in 1937. It remained in the Burmeister family for three generations—George Burmeister took over in 1964 and added stair fabrication, and his son Russell Burmeister shifted the focus to high‑end custom architectural millwork in 1981. In 2015, John Sprenger, a military veteran, acquired the company and serves as president.

The firm produces architectural millwork for luxury residential and commercial projects, including cabinetry, stairs, moldings, and doors. Its 40,000‑square‑foot manufacturing facility in Hales Corners houses a team of about 60 craftsmen who engineer, fabricate, finish, and install each piece. A branch office in Chicago supports project coordination across the Midwest and nationally. The shop combines traditional hand craftsmanship with modern technology and regularly incorporates custom veneers, exotic wood species, metal, glass, and upholstery into complex, technically demanding projects.

Burmeister serves the luxury residential market—creating millwork for high‑end homes, penthouses, and historic renovations—and the commercial sector, with projects such as a modern bank lobby. Clients include architects, designers, and builders throughout the Midwest and across the United States who bring the company their most challenging custom woodwork requirements.

John Sprenger has said he was drawn to the company because of its culture of craftsmanship and the pursuit of excellence he learned in the military, a philosophy that continues to drive the firm’s focus on uncompromising artisanship and turning bold design ideas into reality.

name: Burton Electronics Manufacturing Services
old_description: Our team delivers precise, scalable electronics manufacturing powered by craftsmanship, accountability and pride in every assembly.
about:
Burton Electronics Manufacturing Services (Burton EMS) is a family-owned contract manufacturer founded in 1978 by Edward Leman and James Treiterer in New Berlin, Wisconsin. The company moved to a larger facility in Minocqua in the early 1980s, then built a 6,500-square-foot plant in Hazelhurst in the early 1990s where it added surface-mount assembly. Operational control passed to Gary Burnett Sr. in 1997, and the business expanded into Ironwood, Michigan, where it now operates two manufacturing facilities totaling over 20,000 square feet. Headquarters remain in Hazelhurst, WI.

Burton provides full-lifecycle electronics manufacturing services including PCB assembly (SMT and through-hole), box build, mechanical assembly, spray coating, design and engineering, new product introduction, product lifecycle management, and design-for-manufacturability reviews using VAYO software with 1,500 design rules. The Ironwood facilities house SMT lines with 3D solder paste inspection, automated optical inspection, selective soldering (Orissa Synchrodex), reflow ovens, and a water wash system. The company specializes in high-mix, low-to-medium volume production, supporting programs from prototype through full-rate production.

Burton serves OEMs in the medical, industrial, motor control, specialized consumer, security, building controls, defense, and professional tool markets. Customers rely on the company for turnkey, engineering-intensive projects that demand high reliability and variable-demand responsiveness.

The company attributes its differentiation to a "people-driven" culture emphasizing direct communication, teamwork, proactive problem-solving, and integrity. Its quality system targets a first-pass yield above 99%, warranty returns below 0.5%, and on-time delivery exceeding 97%, supported by ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 certifications, Lean manufacturing, and Six Sigma methodologies.

name: Butterfield Foods LLC
old_description: Since 2011, our SQF 2000 Level 3 status has provided assurance that the products you buy from us have passed rigorous international standards for food safety and quality, including HACCP.
about:
Butterfield Foods LLC operates from Noblesville, Indiana, as a family-owned and operated custom food producer. The company emphasizes its family-owned culture and direct access to ownership, with one employee noting the ability to walk 30 feet to talk to the owner.

The 60,000-square-foot plant houses capabilities including steam-jacketed kettles, steam and convection ovens, spiral freezers, nitrogen tunnels, and high-speed sandwich lines. The company produces soups, sauces, sandwiches, cooked proteins, quesadillas, burritos, and retail entrees, offering services such as recipe commercialization, nutritional analysis, hand assembly, and modified atmosphere packaging in flexible pouches (2–8 lbs) and PET, CPET, or aluminum trays (10 oz–5 lbs). It also provides gluten-free, halal, and kosher assembly.

Butterfield serves food manufacturers, co-packing clients, retail brands, and food-service operators seeking a co-manufacturing partner. Its SQF 2000 Level 3 certification, USDA inspection, and HACCP compliance support customers requiring rigorous food-safety standards, including those needing gluten-free, halal, or kosher production.

The company differentiates itself through a culture of dependability—targeting on-time, defect-free delivery—and culinary integrity led by a Certified Research Chef and a Culinary Institute of America graduate. Management chose the highest GFSI standard (SQF Level 3) in 2011 and maintains on-site microbiological testing to reinforce food safety.

name: C & C Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Since 1974 C&C Manufacturing has been producers of the Mastertrack Trailer line. Let our years of expertise help you to find your perfect trailer.
about:
C & C Manufacturing Inc. operates from Gaithersburg, Maryland, where the business traces its roots to 1974. Boyhood friends Ron Crupi and Scott Campbell formed a partnership to build custom trailers and towing components, launching the Mastertrack brand. In 2012, Dawn Crupi, daughter of one founder, established C & C Manufacturing Inc. to carry forward her father’s legacy, keeping the company family-owned.

The company manufactures the Mastertrack line of trailers — including dump, enclosed, landscape, and equipment models — and maintains a rotating inventory of new and used units. Its shop provides full-service trailer repair, custom fabrication, steel and aluminum welding, electrical work, and Maryland-authorized state and DOT inspections. An in-stock parts department supplies axles, brakes, suspensions, tires, wheels, lighting, cargo hardware, and Dexter Axle components, while the team also installs hitches, gooseneck and fifth-wheel systems, tow-vehicle wiring, and brake controllers.

Customers range from federal agencies such as NASA, the U.S. Navy, the U.S. Army, and the White House to commercial haulers, landscapers, construction firms, and individual trailer owners. The business serves both government contracts and the retail market, offering sales, service, and inspection for a wide variety of towing needs.

From the start, the founders emphasized quality over volume, choosing to build trailers one at a time rather than pursue large-scale expansion. That philosophy remains central: the company states that superior trailers result from focused, piece-by-piece fabrication and a commitment to fast turnaround on repairs.

name: C & T Fabrication
old_description: SPECIALIZING IN STAINLESS STEEL FABRICATION, LASER CUTTING PROCESS PIPING & MATERIAL HANDLING.
about:
C & T Fabrication, located in Sparta, Michigan, was founded in 2003. The company began as a specialist in stainless steel fabrication, laser cutting, process piping, and material handling.

The shop operates a 40,000-square-foot facility equipped with two Mazak CNC fiber optic lasers capable of cutting 1-inch hot-rolled steel and 3/4-inch stainless steel plate, three Accurpress CNC brakes with 3/8-inch by 12-foot bending capacity, plus a steel roller, shear, saw, drill presses, iron worker, tube bender, and scissor lift. Services include precision laser cutting, bending, rolling, welding (TIG, MIG, stick), engineering and design, and on-site installation of fabricated products.

C & T Fabrication serves manufacturers, food processing plants, and pharmaceutical companies, among other sectors. The company builds products for industry leaders and installs them at job sites throughout West Michigan.

The company emphasizes customer satisfaction, superior quality, and authentic relationships, leveraging over 30 years of sheet metal engineering experience to deliver cost-conscious solutions.
